log-only/analyse.candidate: Each module's would-reject rate is measured against every request in the window
A module's verdict depends on how much of the traffic it would reject, with a looser band for the rate limiter
The analysis refuses to report when there is no log to read or no traffic to compute a rate against
A module that actually rejected traffic during a log-only run is called out, with a warning for the whole run
A module that would have rejected nothing is flagged as either clean traffic or not wired in
Mirrored requests are reported as load, not as false positives
The rollout report carries no client identifiers
